run-recovery.mjs already has the live core: agentRun (claude -p --output-format json executor, sums tokensFromUsage, detects Overloaded/529/exec-error as infra), reviewArtifact (claude -p independent SHIP/BLOCK reviewer), runAcceptance, the arm-aware naive-retry+review loop, fixed-point injection.inject(ws,task) at injectAfter, hidden ground-truth scoring, budgetExceeded/replayBudgetLoop/buildRunRecord helpers — but as a standalone script (runMain) doing its OWN classification, with arms a2prime/a4/a4b.

Pre-reg §1 arms = A1 prompt-only (one pass) / A2 naive-retry R=3 / A2prime spend-matched (token+wall budget, token binds first, hard-truncate) / A3 = A2 then EXACTLY one review pass with the SAME reviewer + same structured context snapshot as A4 (reported, not iterated) / A4 full loop with review gate. run-driver ARMS = [A1,A2,A2prime,A3,A4]. a4b is NOT a pre-reg arm.

Offline-testability (the infra-(a) discipline): make agentRun/reviewArtifact INJECTABLE (default live claude -p; the selfcheck passes a deterministic stub) so the adapter + run-driver run with NO claude -p in npm test, like the 5 existing recovery-runner selfchecks.
